opening: Hello, this is Freya Bank's digital assistant. The call is being recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?

lines.text: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.when: When the person answering states that the customer has died
When the customer does not wish to answer the security questions, said once before a final refusal

lines.text: Please say the month as a word.
lines.when: When verify_identity returns a hint that the day and month were swapped

lines.text: Please use the mobile app or a branch for help with your account.
lines.when: After three wrong answers to security questions, before closing

lines.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment on your {{product}}.
lines.when: After identity is verified and account info retrieved

lines.text: Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.when: In response to the customer saying "I already paid"

lines.text: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
I cannot record that amount. The minimum payment is the lowest I can accept.
lines.when: When the customer proposes an amount below the floor and does not accept the floor

lines.text: The customer can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.when: In response to "Is this a scam?"

goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

gated_words.rule: The agent shall say that the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok: true.
Until identity has been verified, the agent shall not say "collections".
Until identity has been verified, the agent shall not say "debt".
Until identity has been verified, the agent shall not say "payment".
Until identity has been verified, the agent shall not say the product.
